Subject: Problem with my loan, please help

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing about my loan, number [ACCOUNT_1]. In June I take a loan of £12,000 from your bank for a car and to pay my other debts. The lady in the Peterborough branch helped me to fill the form on the computer. I told her I work part time as a cleaner and some months I have more hours, some months less, maybe £1,400 in a month. But now I look at the paper from the loan and it says I earn £2,400. This is not correct, I never earned this.

Every month the payment is £289.90 and also I pay rent £750 and I have my son, he is 9. In September I could only pay £120 and in October I could not pay. Now I receive letters and calls, and I am very stressed, I do not sleep well.

I am sorry my English is not perfect. I prefer to write than speak on the phone, because on the phone I do not understand everything quickly.

Please can you check how you gave me this loan when I cannot afford it, and help me with a smaller payment.

Thank you,
[CUSTOMER] ([CUSTOMER])

PL APP 12/06/2026 channel BRANCH Peterborough Bridge St, keyed by user [STAFF]. Applicant [CUSTOMER]. Amount GBP 12,000 term 60m APR 16.9% purpose CAR + DEBT CONSOLIDATION. Employment PART TIME. Declared net income GBP 2,400/m (income verification: WAIVED, low-risk band). Housing GBP 750/m. Dependants 1. Bureau: 2 x credit card combined GBP 6,850. Decision APPROVE. Monthly pmt GBP 289.90. Funds drawn 15/06/2026.

PL [ACCOUNT_1] [CUSTOMER]. Balance GBP 11,402.77. Pmt due 15/09/2026 GBP 289.90, received GBP 120.00. Pmt due 15/10/2026 GBP 289.90, received GBP 0.00. Arrears GBP 459.80. Collections: ACTIVE, strategy STD-1. Letters: arrears L1 18/09, arrears L2 19/10. Outbound calls x6 to [CUSTOMER_PHONE], no contact. Next action: outbound call 23/10.
